title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
summary: Income support for eligible farmer families, paid directly into their bank accounts.
benefits: Money goes directly to the bank account (DBT)
eligibility: Farmer family owning cultivable land
Certain categories, such as institutional landholders, are excluded
Final rules are set by the government
howToApply: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre or local agriculture office
Carry your documents and ask for the PM-KISAN form
Check the official PM-KISAN portal for the latest steps
Keep the acknowledgement for future reference

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
summary: Health insurance cover for hospital treatment for eligible families at empanelled hospitals.
benefits: Cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
eligibility: Families identified under the scheme's official criteria
Eligibility is checked using official lists
Rules may differ slightly by state
howToApply: Check your eligibility on the official PM-JAY portal or at a helpdesk
Visit an empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk
Complete verification with your documents
Collect your Ayushman card if you are eligible

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
summary: Financial help for eligible families to build or buy a pucca house.
eligibility: Families without a pucca house, as per scheme rules
Income and category conditions apply
Rules differ for urban and rural areas
howToApply: Find out whether you are in the urban (PMAY-U) or rural (PMAY-G) area
Contact your municipal office or Gram Panchayat
Fill out the application with your documents
Follow up for verification

title: PM MUDRA Yojana
summary: Collateral-free loans for small businesses and self-employed people.
benefits: Loans for small and micro businesses
Different loan categories for different needs
No collateral needed for these loans
eligibility: Small business owners and new entrepreneurs
Non-farm income-generating activity
Lender conditions apply
documents: Business plan or proof of business
howToApply: Visit a bank, cooperative bank or microfinance lender
Ask for the Mudra loan application
Submit your documents and business details
Wait for the lender's decision

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
summary: A small savings scheme to support the future education and marriage expenses of a girl child.
benefits: Savings account for a girl child
Interest rate is set by the government from time to time
Tax benefits as per current law
eligibility: Account for a girl child below 10 years of age
Opened by a parent or legal guardian
Rules limit the number of accounts per family
documents: Parent or guardian ID and address proof
howToApply: Visit a post office or authorised bank
Fill out the account opening form
Make the first deposit
Keep the passbook safely

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
summary: Short-term skill training and certification to help young people find work.
eligibility: Young people looking for skill training
Age and education conditions depend on the course
Check the official portal for current rules
howToApply: Search for a nearby training centre on the official portal
Choose a course
Register with your documents
Attend the training and assessment

title: Swachh Bharat Mission
summary: A national campaign for cleanliness, toilets and better waste management in urban and rural areas.
benefits: Support for toilet construction in eligible households
eligibility: Eligible households as per local guidelines
Urban and rural parts have different rules
Ask your local body for details
howToApply: Contact your municipal office or Gram Panchayat
Ask about the sanitation support available
Fill out the form if you qualify
Follow local verification steps

title: Atal Pension Yojana
summary: A pension scheme for people who work in the unorganised sector.
benefits: Pension amounts range from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month depending on contribution
Contribution depends on your age when you join
eligibility: Age 18 to 40 years
Must have a savings bank account
Mobile number linked to the account
howToApply: Visit your bank or post office
Fill out the Atal Pension Yojana form
Choose your pension amount
Keep funds in your account for the monthly contribution
